title: OmniaCSS config (omnia.config.json)
description: Settings for "omniacss build". Command-line flags override them.

content.description: Glob patterns of the files to scan for class names.

components.description: Include the OmniaUI component CSS (@birdycom/omniaui). "auto": only when installed.

pro.description: Include the OmniaUI Pro CSS (@birdycom/omniaui-pro, licensed). "auto": only when installed.

layer.description: Cascade layer that wraps the output, or false for none.

keep.description: Class names to keep even when no content file uses them (for example classes built at runtime).

minify.description: Minify the output with Lightning CSS.
